extension.summary: Sync Kodi favourites.xml with cloud storage
extension.description: Synchronise Kodi favourites across devices using WebDAV, S3, SFTP, SMB/NAS, NFS, or local paths. Supports bidirectional merge, scheduled sync, and conflict resolution.
extension.news: v1.0.75: Refactor and enhance profile synchronization and management Improved cross-add functionality to utilize source profile defaults and allow editing of default targets. Added deep copy for profile configurations to prevent unintended mutations during edits. Updated backend configuration handling to ensure proper mapping and encryption of sensitive fields. Implemented atomic file operations with process-safe locks to prevent data corruption during concurrent writes. Enhanced regression tests to cover various scenarios including upload failures, profile sync isolation, and credential handling. Introduced new modules for backend configuration and storage management to streamline code organization and maintainability. Updated documentation to reflect changes and improvements in functionality and testing procedures.
